title: Decarboxylation of fatty acids to fuel additives over a ruthenium-dispersed MWW zeolite framework
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5601-5611
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00530B, Paper
N. P. Nimisha, Soumya B. Narendranath, K. K. Shabana, C. P. Ansiya, C. K. Swetha, Anil Chandra Kothari, Adarsh Sahu, Rajaram Bal, A. Sakthivel
In situ produced metallic Ru is well-dispersed within the 10-MR channels and 12-MR external pockets of the MWW framework, demonstrated as a potential catalyst for the selective decarboxylation of biomass-derived lauric acid into gasoline additives.
